# Analytics Output — Generated Files

JSON files produced by the ML pipeline.
All files are gitignored and regenerated on each pipeline run.

---

## File Reference

### ML Output

| File | Size | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| 00_ml_output_full.json | ~9 MB | All sessions + cluster assignments |
| 00_ml_output_full.csv | ~3 MB | Same data as CSV |

### Analytics Layers

| File | Size | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| 02_cluster_analytics.json | ~3 KB | Raw cluster counts |
| 02_cluster_analytics_enriched.json | ~70 KB | Clusters + behaviors (main output) |
| 03_temporal_analytics.json | ~12 KB | Timeline + periods |
| 04_session_analytics.json | ~12 KB | KPIs + alerts + distributions |
| 05_mitre_analytics_lite.json | ~7 KB | MITRE summary (use this) |
| 05_mitre_analytics.json | ~2.7 MB | MITRE full (with relationships) |
| 05_mitre_analytics_sessions.json | ~2.7 MB | Session-to-MITRE relationships |
| 06_mitre_statistics.json | ~22 KB | MITRE stats table |
| 07_mitre_trends.json | ~57 KB | MITRE time-series |

### Session Replay

| File | Size | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| 08_session_replay_list.json | ~7.5 MB | Sessions list (dashboard table) |
| 08_session_replay_index.json | ~16 MB | Index of all sessions |
| 08_session_replay_full.json | ~74 MB | Full sessions (rarely needed) |
| 08_session_replay_sample.json | ~590 KB | First 100 sessions |
| session_replay_details/ | ~25 MB | 367 individual session files |

---

## Which File to Use

| Goal | File |
|---|---|
| Backend handoff | Use backend_handoff/ml_analytics_files/ (via package_handoff.sh) |
| MITRE summary | 05_mitre_analytics_lite.json |
| MITRE full relationships | 05_mitre_analytics_sessions.json |
| Session table | 08_session_replay_list.json |
| Single session detail | session_replay_details/<id>.json |
| Offline analysis | 08_session_replay_full.json (large) |

---

## File Naming

| Suffix | Meaning |
|---|---|
| _full | Complete data, largest size |
| _lite | Reduced version, smaller |
| _index | Index or summary |
| _sample | Small sample for testing |
| _enriched | Raw data plus metadata |

---

## Regeneration

All files are regenerated by:

    bash scripts/run_ml_pipeline.sh

The folder can be safely deleted; the pipeline recreates it.
